# Data Structure

> Korean-language course materials from Pusan National University: lecture slides (PDF), interactive topic pages, and concept-check problem sets.

Instructor: [YongKyung Oh](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/people/yongkyung-oh/)

## Lectures

- [Structure and Cost](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/00.%20Intro.pdf) (PDF)
- [Data Abstraction](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/01.%20Data%20Abstraction.pdf) (PDF): [Data Abstraction](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/data-abstraction.html), [Operations and Semantics](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/operations-and-semantics.html), [ADT Specifications](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/adt-specifications.html), [Choosing an ADT](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/choosing-an-adt.html), [Concept check: Data Abstraction and ADTs](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/practice/data-abstraction-and-adts.html)
- [Interfaces](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/02.%20Interfaces.pdf) (PDF): [Interface and Specification](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/interface-and-specification.html), [Representation and Work](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/representation-and-work.html), [Python Objects](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/python-objects.html), [Two Implementations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/two-implementations.html), [Concept check: Interfaces and Implementations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/practice/interfaces-and-implementations.html)
- [Measuring Cost](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/03.%20Measuring%20Cost.pdf) (PDF): [Timing a Run](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/03.%20Measuring%20Cost/timing-a-run.html), [Counting Operations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/03.%20Measuring%20Cost/counting-operations.html), [Loops and Input Size](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/03.%20Measuring%20Cost/loops-and-input-size.html), [Python Operations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/03.%20Measuring%20Cost/python-operations.html), [Concept check: Running Time and Operation Counts](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/practice/measuring-cost.html)

- [Storing Elements in a Row](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/05.%20Storing%20Elements%20in%20a%20Row.pdf) (PDF): [Contiguous Storage](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/05.%20Storing%20Elements%20in%20a%20Row/contiguous-storage.html), [Backing Array](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/05.%20Storing%20Elements%20in%20a%20Row/backing-array.html), [Cost of Shifting](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/05.%20Storing%20Elements%20in%20a%20Row/cost-of-shifting.html), [What Arrays Are Good For](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/05.%20Storing%20Elements%20in%20a%20Row/what-arrays-are-good-for.html), [Concept check: Arrays](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/practice/arrays.html)
- [When the Array Fills Up](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/06.%20When%20the%20Array%20Fills%20Up.pdf) (PDF): [Capacity and Resize](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/06.%20When%20the%20Array%20Fills%20Up/capacity-and-resize.html), [Amortized Cost](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/06.%20When%20the%20Array%20Fills%20Up/amortized-cost.html), [Inside Python Lists](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/06.%20When%20the%20Array%20Fills%20Up/inside-python-lists.html), [Circular Arrays](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/06.%20When%20the%20Array%20Fills%20Up/circular-arrays.html), [Concept check: Dynamic Arrays](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/practice/dynamic-arrays.html)
